comment: §1.1 自動化集中（2026-09-22 總督核定；P0-4）— 全自動化流程清單與 owner。自動化核心（AutomationCore）是唯一排程／觸發註冊點：kind=periodic 的流程一律經核心註冊到共享 PeriodicScheduler；kind=event/on-demand 僅登錄觸發器（無自有排程）；kind=supervision-plane 為監督面流程（位於被監督行程之外，設計上不正屬於本註冊面）。enabled=false 為 kill switch：拒絕註冊並停跑，全程審計。清單外流程不得註冊排程（A10 allowlist，fail-closed）。

kill_switch.comment: flow.enabled=false → 註冊拒絕＋既有註冊解除；runtime/state/automation-flows-state.json 提供同语义 runtime override（disable 持久化）。清單檔與狀態檔皆受管設定。

git-automation.owner: GPTBridge.GitAutomation.exe --watch (C# resident host; Python tasks/git_automation.py retired)
git-automation.description: C# host 內含 worktree self-commit sweep（debounce）＋workspace sync cycle；Python task 只 spawn/活性探測/有界 respawn，不執行 git 工作（C66 單一編排器）；host 每週期重讀 enabled＋runtime override，sentinel 檔觸發優雅停止；push=協調者推送 main→origin（§10.69-E①：非 force、ancestor 檢查、稽核 PASS＋強制測試 PASS 才推；推送與 ahead==0 收斂證據入帳）

daily-global-cleaner.description: retired (B167/B38): Python daily-global-cleaner removed with the Python lane; daily cleanup duty recorded for a native port. 原職責：每日全域清理（due-gated，實際執行依 is_due 期限）。

system-automation-coordinator.description: retired (B167/B38): Python decision-layer coordinator removed with the Python lane; sovereign health aggregation duty recorded for a native port. 原職責：主宰健康聚合＋退化路由；內部自適應 60–300 s 與熔斷保留。

maintenance-controller.description: retired (B167/B38): Python maintenance_controller removed with the Python lane; maintenance signal duty recorded for a native port. 原職責：PG/SQLite/reconcile/backup 維護信號 tick。

sleep-policy.description: retired (B167/B38): Python SleepPolicyManager removed with the Python lane; idle-tiering duty recorded for a native port. 原職責：sleepable 單元 idle 分層掃描（hot→warm→cold＋需求喚醒回退）。

permission-automation-lifecycle.description: native port delivered (B167/B38): shared-layer/csharp/GPTBridge.Permission — grant expiry sweep, delegated auto-renew adjudication, revoke/suspend, 30-day terminal cleanup; stays disabled until a resident automation host registers it. 原職責：權限授予過期／自動續期檢查（發權/收權/停權）。

permission-automation-directory.description: native port delivered (B167/B38): shared-layer/csharp/GPTBridge.Permission — managed-registry sync hash (code-rules initial version + authority current version + sealed identity count); stays disabled until a resident automation host registers it. 原職責：受管目錄快照同步（雜湊比對）。

permission-automation-compliance.description: native port delivered (B167/B38): shared-layer/csharp/GPTBridge.Permission — violation ingestion/dedup/severity, directory integrity, ledger-vs-directory drift (A436), hourly risk-score decay; stays disabled until a resident automation host registers it. 原職責：合規檢查／違規處理／風險評分。

permission-automation-healing.owner: GPTBridge.Permission.SelfHealingAutomation (C# library; RunOnceAsync driven by the automation host)
permission-automation-healing.description: native port delivered (B167/B38): shared-layer/csharp/GPTBridge.Permission — four health checks (registry access, governance connection, sovereign state, directory permissions) with injected governed repair delegates (A297); stays disabled until a resident automation host registers it. 原職責：權限平面自我修復健康檢查。

permission-automation-audit.description: native port delivered (B167/B38): shared-layer/csharp/GPTBridge.Permission — bounded native audit-engine invocation (60s timeout, metadata-only history records); stays disabled until a resident automation host registers it. 原職責：定期治理審計子行程。

permission-automation-identity.owner: GPTBridge.Permission.IdentityGroupLifecycleAutomation (C# library; RunOnceAsync driven by the automation host)
permission-automation-identity.description: native port delivered (B167/B38): shared-layer/csharp/GPTBridge.Permission — auto-register sealed groups missing locally, sovereign-decided deletion of unregistered retired-tool groups (A297 fail-closed pending), duplicate-actor conflict resolution, metadata-only lifecycle ledger. 原職責：身份組註冊與刪除自動化（協調層，封印登錄不可寫）。

connection-watchdog.description: 前端/後端連線探針已由 Rust lifecycle monitor 承接（子行程活性探測＋attached-backend 探針＋有界自動重啟佇列）。監督面正確歸屬：監督者不得位於被監督行程之自動化核心內（A69 分層；主行程 hang 時仍須可探針與修復），非待遷移項

state-outbox.description: 交易式 outbox：狀態變更事件＋重試期限驅動（無固定輪詢）；由原生後端承接：session/generation/cursor 協定＋批次 drain＋未確認重送＋min-acked 修剪

model-service-activation.description: retired (B167/B38): Python activation broker removed with the Python lane; ai→xingcheng on-demand activation duty (A540) recorded for a native port. 原職責：偵測佇列 ai→xingcheng 請求並按需啟動 local-model。

channel-host-supervision.description: 通道層自動化：依 shared-layer/manifest.json background_service 契約（managed_by=main-system、auto_restart、max_restart_attempts=5、restart_backoff_seconds=1）由原生後端 spawn＋監督受管 GPTBridge.ChannelHost.exe（A263 通道）；受管關閉抑制重啟、預算耗盡 fail-closed；狀態檔 runtime/state/channel-host.json、稽核 channel-host.jsonl。監督者位於被監督行程之外（A170 邊界）

codex-pipeline-supervision.description: 管線自動化：由原生後端 spawn＋監督 GPTBridge.CodexPipeline.exe --watch 常駐 host（codex-amendment-intake / codex-pin-sync / codex-maintenance 三 flow 的執行主體；flow 級 kill switch 在 watch loop 內逐 tick 生效）。重啟預算同 channel-host 契約（5 次／1s backoff，外部 force-close 仍重啟）；preflight 以 codex-automation.lock 單例鎖仲裁——外部實例持有時延後接管而不耗預算。缺 exe 或 GPTBRIDGE_POSTGRES_DSN 時 fail-closed。狀態檔 runtime/state/codex-pipeline.json、稽核 codex-pipeline.jsonl；host 自身狀態 codex-automation.json

permission-host-supervision.description: 監督面自動化：由原生後端 spawn＋監督 GPTBridge.Permission.exe --watch 常駐 host（permission-automation-lifecycle/directory/compliance/healing/audit/identity 六 flow 的執行主體；各 flow 的 kill switch 在 watch loop 內逐 tick 生效）。重啟預算同 channel-host 契約（5 次、1s backoff，外部 force-close 仍重啟）；preflight 以 permission-automation.lock 仲裁——外部實例持有時延後、釋放後收編，避免重複實例燒光重啟預算。缺 publish exe 即 fail-closed。狀態：runtime/state/permission-host.json＋稽核 permission-host.jsonl；host 自身狀態 permission-automation.json

resource-governor.description: §10.64 資源管制：native/resource_governor/bin/resource-governor.exe 獨立行程（C++23，Windows 工作排程／登入啟動）。監督面正確歸屬：管制對象含主系統本身，管制者必須活得比被管制者久（A170 監督邊界），非待遷移項。kill switch 只停動作不停觀測

rag-schema-migration.description: retired (B167/B38): Python RagRuntimeIntegration removed with the Python lane; schema-drift governed entry recorded for a native port（向量軸由 vectord-rs rebuild_canonical 承接）。原職責：P2/G50 schema-drift 受管入口，僅 operator／受管流程顯式呼叫。

resource-mode-advisor.description: retired (B167/B38): Python resource_mode_advisor removed with the Python lane; auto-adjust tick driver recorded for a native port。機制已承接：gptbridge-backend resource_mode.rs 持有 rules/state/advisor 檔案契約、22:00-07:00 夜間評估、resource-mode-audit.jsonl 稽核與 app:set/get-resource-mode 命令；缺 60s 週期驅動器。原職責：需求驅動＋夜間睡眠省電自動調整（22-07 強制 sleep；strained→low 立即；worker 需求＋餘裕→high；high/medium 連續 3 次評估＋600s 冷卻；auto_mode 預設 true，手動選檔關閉 auto）。

file-sorter-automation.description: retired (B167/B38): FileSorterAutomationService removed with the Python lane; governed file-sorter loop duty recorded for a native port. 原職責：standalone 工具行程內的受管檔案整理 loop（級距調整 10s→24h、signals/automation-wake.json 喚醒、recover_transactions→prune_state→run_enabled_profiles_once）。kill switch：manifest automation.enabled

xingcheng-internal-maintenance.description: retired (B167/B38): _internal_maintenance_loop removed with the Python training/maintenance lane

vaultly-auto-scan.description: retired (B167/B38): VaultlyScanMixin._auto_scan_loop removed with the Python lane; platform auto-scan/download scheduling duty recorded for a native port. 原職責：清單登記（inventory-only）平台自動掃描＋下載 job 排程（成功 30min、錯誤重試 30s）；repository.prune_state 啟動修剪（jobs≤200/post_scan_jobs≤100/entity_history 每實體≤20 版本）。

package-version-sync.description: retired (B167/B38): Python package_version_driver removed with the Python lane; A624 duty remains recorded for a native driver port. 原職責：每 tick 偵測已安裝工具鏈／套件版本→ mode=upgrade 執行升級→漂移時產生 codex-amendment-request 投遞 convergence intake；driver 永不直寫權威庫。

architecture-artifact-sync.description: retired (B167/B38): Python codex_sync_drivers removed with the Python lane; artifact-hash drift detection duty remains recorded for a native driver port. 原職責：對 architecture_diagram_artifact_registry active 列做 byte-level SHA-256 比對，漂移時產生 codex-amendment-request。

codex-pin-sync.description: Release contract 法典釘定收斂：每 tick 讀 PostgreSQL 權威 authority_state，與 shared-layer/release-dependencies.json 的 governance_references codex_version/codex_sha256 比對，漂移時外科式改寫該兩欄位（實作面檔案，非權威寫入；落盤由 self-commit 收檔）。kill switch：本 flow enabled=false

codex-maintenance.description: Codex 產物/投影維護（SQL 全自動化）：每 tick 檢查 governance_codex.sql 產物存在性 → verify-parity（隔離 stage schema 比對 218 表）→ codex_search_document 污染探針（??）→ zh-TW 鏡像一致性。drift 時先 repair-projections 重建 live 衍生表再複驗；權威本身已合法漂移才重新 export 產物並重算鏡像（AtomicReplace 唯讀復原）。本 pass 永不寫入權威表。kill switch：本 flow enabled=false

codex-amendment-intake.owner: GPTBridge.CodexPipeline.exe --watch (C# resident host; codex-amendment-intake tick → Driver.AdvanceAll)
codex-amendment-intake.description: Codex 修訂請求管線驅動（pausable=false 保障治理關鍵路徑不受資源管制/睡眠模式暫停）：掃描受管 intake（main-system/runtime/state 與 governance_rule/execution/audit/convergence 的 codex-amendment-request-*.json）→ ledger.begin 取得 lineage lock → build_successor 建候選（PG 權威匯出為 non-authoritative .sql artifact）→ run_five_sovereign_audit → ready-for-governor → auto_execute=true 時經 codex_amendment_executor 自動解除唯讀、ATOMIC-PUBLISH 至 PostgreSQL 權威、恢復唯讀並封印（五主權一致稽核憑證為封印條件，executor 於變更前重新驗證；失敗一律終態 rejected，owner 以 -rN 重送）。auto_execute=false 時停在 ready-for-governor 由 human governor 手動 codex_amendment_executor --apply。xingcheng 收據需 governed web-search callable（xingcheng_web_search 經 GovernedRequestClient → local-model）；未接線時 defer（successor-built）而非永久拒絕。CLI：shared-layer/csharp/GPTBridge.CodexPipeline/publish/GPTBridge.CodexPipeline.exe --scan|--request|--all [--auto-execute]（Python driver 已退役 B167/B38）
